subject: desk
name: 书桌
label: 抽屉小书桌
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One simple front-facing desk with a broad top, one central drawer and four straight legs.
Clearly connected purposeful construction, empty white interior, no texture or dense repeated decoration. No gray shading, no small screw heads, no added objects on or around the subject.
Entire subject fully visible centered within 12 percent margin.
